newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Commercial Bk Korea to set $50 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Bk Korea to set $50 mln FRN.

text.p: Commercial Bank of Korea has verbally mandated five banks to arrange a US$50 million floating rate note issue, bankers said on Monday.
They said the facility has a final maturity of three years with no put or call options.
The issue was priced at par to float at 30 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
The front-end fee is 15 basis points for top-tier managers.
Arrangers are Bear Stearns, CS First Boston, Dresdner Bank, Merrill Lynch Asia Pacific and Sanwa International Finance. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2847 4039
